snippet.title: Welcome to the mansion of HELL! (Luigi's Haunted Quest 2: Bligmire: Part #1)
snippet.description:
The first part of the also highly underrated Luigi's Haunted Quest 2: Bligmire. With 1 whole hour of extreme difficulty, change, and uncanniness.

Luigi's Haunted Quest 2: Bligmire (also known as Luigi's Mansion: Bligmire: Haunted Quest 2 or simply Luigi's Haunted Quest 2 or LHQ2/LHQ2:B if you don't have much time), is another very dark Luigi's Mansion mod that is the sequel to Luigi's Haunted Quest 1. This mod takes place some unknown time after King Boo (Bowser) was defeated forever and Mario was saved from him. A new threat has emerged. This time, it is now an evil monstrous otherworldly entity known as, "Bligmire". Bligmire is responsible for creating his paranormal active hellfire mansion, kidnapping Dr. Meshki and holding him captive, and plaguing Mario with a curse that turned him into small Mario which only Dr. Meshki can cure. Luigi himself is alive and well due to the mansion not actually being in hell, but the outside and inside are environmentally hellish due to Bligmire's presence. Upon entering the mansion, Luigi already encounters a fuckton of ghosts with way too much health in very small, janky collision rooms who senselessly beat his ass! Of course, Luigi doesn't stand for this and gets back at all of them while collecting keys and valuable treasure.

Music used during the sped up parts in the Bowser's Castle, Baron, Memory, and Wario's Treasure Hoard rooms:

Bowser's Castle, The Barons Room, and Memory: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8QOg_fe5ug

Wario's Treasure Hoard: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e4ZmZy6F-9g

Mod by Golden Luigi Napier: https://mega.nz/fm/Q5Z2CDyS

Tags: #luigismansion #hell #hellfire
